issues: 整卡 opacity 淡出连纸一起淡，最后 8 帧画面掉成灰黑，交棒时像断电
压印只有 scale 1.28→1 单段，没有"压进纸面再回弹"的落点，读起来像普通放大淡入
8 个词等间隔 4f，句子 41f 才压完，下划线与副行在句子没写完时就提前出场，抢戏
纸底只有一层径向渐变，没有纸纹与边缘收光，画面偏平
副行 mono 26px、颜色浅，低于 Q11 辅助字高，数字滚动无运动感
changes: 压印改三段：前 72% 用 bezier(0.2,0.75,0.3,1) 从 1.28 压到 0.985，再 ease-out 回弹到 1；悬空时投随高度收缩的暖色软影，落纸后换成 1px 凹印高光
逐词间隔 4f→3f 越压越快（4/8/12/15/18/21/24/27f），句子 37f 落定；下划线挪到 24→38f、副行 26→38f、数字 27→43f，层层跟随
纸底加竖向微渐变 + 中心暖光 + 极弱暖色暗角 + multiply 纤维颗粒，全程极缓推近 1→1.012（smooth）
尾部只淡出墨：字/线/副行 8f 上浮 10px + 4px 虚化退场，纸面保留，末帧恰好干净
字体换 New York/ui-serif 栈、墨色带暖色相；副行提到 mono 30px、数字 600 字重并按滚速加竖向拖影
issuesEn: The whole card faded via opacity, paper included, so the last 8 frames dropped to grey-black like a power cut
The press was a single scale 1.28→1 step with no 'into the paper and back' landing; it read as a plain zoom-fade
Eight words on an even 4f stagger, sentence only done at 41f, and the underline/sub line appeared before the sentence finished
Paper was a single radial gradient with no fibre or edge falloff, so the frame felt flat
Sub line was 26px light mono, below the Q11 auxiliary text height, and the digit roll had no sense of motion
changesEn: Three-stage press: first 72% eases 1.28→0.985 with bezier(0.2,0.75,0.3,1), then eases back to 1; a warm soft shadow shrinks as the word lands, replaced by a 1px debossed highlight
Stagger tightens from 4f to 3f (4/8/12/15/18/21/24/27f), sentence lands at 37f; underline moved to 24→38f, sub line 26→38f, digits 27→43f so each layer follows the last
Paper gets a vertical tint, warm centre light, faint warm vignette and multiply fibre grain, plus a slow 1→1.012 smooth push-in
Exit fades only the ink: text/rule/sub line rise 10px and blur 4px over 8f while the paper stays; last frame is clean
New York/ui-serif stack with warm-tinted ink; sub line raised to 30px mono, 600-weight digits with speed-based vertical blur
